verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only that Google Calendar offers appointment booking pages (a pricing-page line item). Nothing documents buffers before or after meetings, minimum notice, daily booking caps, or date-range availability windows. Booking pages are a different story's capability and do not transfer to these calendar-protection controls.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can protect my calendar with buffers before and after meetings, minimum notice, daily booking caps, and date-range windows
